scripts.build: XDG_CACHE_HOME=.cache vp run openbot:generate && vp run contracts:generate && XDG_CACHE_HOME=.cache vp run -r build
scripts.check: XDG_CACHE_HOME=.cache vp run openbot:generate && vp run contracts:generate && XDG_CACHE_HOME=.cache vp check && vp run --filter @openbot/contracts lint && vp run --filter @openbot/control-service-proto lint && vp run test
scripts.contracts:generate: XDG_CACHE_HOME=.cache vp run --filter @openbot/contracts generate && XDG_CACHE_HOME=.cache vp run --filter @openbot/control-service-proto generate
scripts.test: vp test run scripts && vp run -r test
scripts.typecheck: XDG_CACHE_HOME=.cache vp run openbot:generate && vp run contracts:generate && XDG_CACHE_HOME=.cache vp check --no-fmt --no-lint
